items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: my father was teaching at Le Moine College in Memphis at that point... He said, 'I taught -- James was a very nice boy.'

ctx.x: No -- well, okay. But it was just nice to know, and they tell me that the house is still standing there and people are still living in it, you know?
You mentioned that your father taught English to Jimmie Lunceford.
